modules.plainZh: 副機對齊房間已發佈的 live OS 映像（App bits + gateway + OS skillet.md），不是 git 重編。
modules.notes: 2026-08-15: one consumer channel only — scripts/tatwo-os-image.sh. Git rebuild is a room-side recipe, not an update. helper TATWO_AUTO_VERSION=0. sync-request version-pull is retired on os-image consumers. Identity is TatwoOsImageV1 imageId, not 0.1.x marketing strings. OS skill slot is skillet/SKILL.md (host skillet.md); tatwo-ultrawork/SKILL.md stays a product skill and is not overwritten by this channel.

modules.plainZh: 本機 tatwo-ultrawork CLI 還沒有跨機運輸，先單獨列出來避免跟 App 混裝。
modules.notes: No transport yet. Replacing the CLI binary invalidates that host's Keychain key ACL (cdhash-bound), so the host must re-enroll after an update. Target-side key create/read over SSH fails with -25308; needs a GUI session. Do not piggyback CLI replace onto os-app-version until a stable signing identity exists.

modules.plainZh: 非主設備發起的 skill 提案箱。主設備已簽名的 system-pull 會在目標機自動套用（LWW+archive）；此箱只收 lane／非 owner 提案，不覆蓋本機 skill，不灌進 OS。
modules.notes: 2026-08-15: skillet-lane is inbox-only proposal box. Owner-signed system-pull auto-applies LWW+archive at the target (displaced revisions stay content-addressed). TATWO_SKILLET_APPLY defaults 0 on live machines so import-activate and Codex/Claude native projection never overwrite local skills. TATWO_SKILLET_LANE_PUBLISH defaults 0 so the whole store is not mass-exported. Unsigned lane requests are quarantined once. OS common skill is skillet.md (not this store). Last store consume was 2026-07-27.

modules.plainZh: 主設備統整的 OS 常用技能。各家保有自己的 SKILL.md，用 $skillet 或 /skillet 讀這一份。提案送回主機，不覆蓋。
modules.notes: 2026-08-15: host canonical is TATWO-ULTRAWORKos/skillet.md. Wrappers are skillet/SKILL.md only. Unify archives proposals and never auto-replaces the curated body or any vendor SKILL.md. OS image versions skillet, not tatwo-ultrawork.

modules.plainZh: 外掛與 MCP 清單一次登記，各設備自動生效。
modules.notes: Catalog registry.plugins is deferredSystemPull (relativePath registries/plugins). No adapter on the live system-pull allowlist. Must not grow a private transport; enable only through this module + catalog gate.

modules.plainZh: 精選記憶（GBrain curated 層）跨設備可用。
modules.notes: Catalog memory.gbrain-curated is deferred (relativePath memory/gbrain-curated, mergePolicy curatedProposal). Host backup and user-data migration are local-only and must not be reused as a cross-device pipe.

modules.plainZh: 模型身分與協作預設在各設備保持一致。
modules.notes: Live transport=device-sync-channel (profiles/shared + registries/models), not the 4-item system-pull atomic set. Owner-initiated auto-apply; gateway LaunchAgent reloads only when roster hash changes. Payload is roster/route + agent-presets only — credential-looking keys fail closed on publish. TatwoModelIdentityRegistry already rides app version and is hashed, never overlaid. Catalog registry.models stays deferred so secrets cannot ride system-pull.

modules.plainZh: 治理文件（os.md／issue.md／TODO.md）跟著主設備走。主設備已簽名的 system-pull 在目標機直接套用並封存上一版；提案箱只留給非 owner 發起的變更。
modules.notes: Three legs today: (1) system-pull originals os.constitution/os.issue/os.todo on device-sync-channel, (2) profile os-mirror-* into App Support profile-mirrors/, (3) local tatwo-doc-project.sh projection with no S2 transport. Consolidation target=device-sync-channel. Keep projector as offline/read-only UI; mark os-mirror deprecated.

modules.plainZh: Goal 尚未 iCloud。legacy db-pull 只單向搬 state/goals，不可稱 converged。
modules.notes: Catalog work.goal-state is deferred (relativePath work-os/goals). Legacy db-pull only allowlists state/goals over pipe.ssh-rsync-db with --delete — high-risk bypass, default off, do not expand the allowlist. Formal cross-device goals must use a catalog adapter on device-sync-channel.

modules.plainZh: 正文留在各自設備，不會被主機覆蓋。一鍵送回主機統整差異。
modules.notes: 2026-07-23 decision: phase-1 Domain Data Sync excludes threads/message body from device-sync-channel system-pull. Four walls still hold: catalog chat.native-threads stays in deferredSystemPullItemIDs, db-pull allowlist is state/goals only, doc projector rejects threads/.thread, enablement/runtime mutations are refused. 2026-08-15: manual one-click uses scripts/tatwo-data-sync.sh submit → host unify. Secondary live files are never overwritten.

modules.plainZh: 主機把已簽名工作丟進密封 loop-channel，對端跑完再收回候選結果。
modules.notes: pipe.loop-channel-rsync; rsync -rt --update; forbid --delete/-E. Enable only after dual-device pin + seal-install. Transport is zero-trust; consume high-water stays in Keychain and must not sync. Fleet control-plane dirs stay origin-local.

modules.plainZh: 每台設備回報型號、晶片、RAM、CPU%、記憶體壓力、連線與進行中 loops，供派工看負荷。
modules.notes: Local App monitor is the admission authority. Host inventory (hw.model/chip/RAM/CPU%/memory-pressure/connection/active-loop-count) is display + readiness enrichment and must not override classify(). Fleet readiness manifests ride loop-channel; they are not a second admission oracle.

modules.plainZh: 兩台先交換公鑰，其他簽名腿才算數；私鑰永不離開 Keychain。
modules.notes: pipe.oob-pin. Copying a registry file is not trust. device-trust list-pins is not a read-only probe (it can write pin-store); do not use it as statusProbe. Private keys never leave Keychain. Prerequisite for signed sync-request, skillet-bundle, and remote-loops.
